tagline: Feed-forward compressor with hard or soft knee
description: A compressor with threshold, ratio, attack, release and a hard or soft knee. Each channel has its own envelope follower, and a fixed makeup gain is added based on threshold and ratio. A meter shows gain reduction.

features.name: Threshold and Ratio
features.description: Threshold -60 dB to 0 dB (default -12 dB), ratio 1:1 to 20:1 (default 4:1)

features.name: Attack and Release
features.description: Attack 0.1 ms to 100 ms, release 10 ms to 1000 ms, both skewed toward short times

features.name: Hard or Soft Knee
features.description: Hard knee, or a 6 dB soft knee with a quadratic transition

features.name: Automatic Makeup Gain
features.description: Adds half the gain reduction a -12 dB signal would get at the current threshold and ratio

features.name: Gain Reduction Meter
features.description: Shows gain reduction over a 0 to 20 dB range

useCases: Add sustain to bass and guitars
Learn how threshold, ratio, attack and release interact
learningFocus: Envelope follower design with attack/release coefficients
Hard vs. soft knee compression curves
Exponential time constants for envelope smoothing
Per-channel state management for stereo processing

algorithms.name: Envelope Follower
algorithms.description: Tracks input level with exponential attack/release coefficients calculated from time parameters

algorithms.name: Soft Knee Gain Reduction
algorithms.description: Gradual transition using a quadratic curve across a 6 dB knee
